alternate_names: Purnea Panch Mukhi Shiv Hanuman Mandir

history.summary: Coordinates (25.782136, 87.483186) are from a web place listing for this temple, not the map geocoder (rate-limited); treat as web-corroborated, not field-verified. POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of seq 151 ('Hanuman Mandir', id panchmukhi-hanuman-mandir-purnia), which documents this same prominent Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir at Forbesganj Chowk, Line Bazar, PWD Colony, Purnia. This file documents that same temple: a highly-visited Panchmukhi (five-faced) Hanuman shrine; its own official page styles it 'Purnea Panch Mukhi Shiv Hanuman Mandir' (Regd.), so Shiva is also venerated. It stands beside NH 31 at Forbesganj Chowk, Line Bazar, Purnia 854301 (also listed under Khazanchi Hat / PWD Colony, Purnia). Note: a second, much smaller 'Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir' listing exists at Rambagh, Purnia (Road no. 6, SNSY College Rd, ~1.64 km from Purnea Junction) — if the CSV intended that one, this identification is wrong. A YouTube video title claims the temple is 600 years old; no corroborating source was found, so antiquity is unverified.

name: Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir, Purnia
town_description: Purnia (also Purnea) is a city in northeastern Bihar and the headquarters of Purnia district and division. An educational and commercial hub of the Seemanchal-Kosi region, it is nicknamed 'Mini Darjeeling' and takes its name from goddess Puran Devi (Puran Aranya).

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 160-170 km by road; Purnia's own airport is under development.
travel.railway: Purnea Junction, a major railhead, lies within the city; a Rambagh listing places the temple ~1.64 km from the junction.
travel.road: Beside NH 31 at Forbesganj Chowk, Line Bazar; NH 27 also passes through Purnia; reachable by bus, auto-rickshaw and taxi.

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Tuesdays and Saturdays draw the largest crowds at Hanuman shrines (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: CONFLICT (verify): Justdial lists 'Open 24 Hrs'; the temple's official page lists 6 AM-1 PM and 3-9 PM daily.
